description: This is a unit test source file for the BasketService, specifically testing the TransferBasketAsync method. It contains multiple test cases verifying the behavior of basket transfer logic, including handling anonymous and user baskets, item transfer, deletion, and creation.

classes.name: TransferBasket
classes.description: Unit test class for BasketService.TransferBasketAsync method, contains setup data and mocks.

methods.name: InvokesBasketRepositoryFirstOrDefaultAsyncOnceIfAnonymousBasketNotExists
methods.description: Test case verifying that the repository's FirstOrDefaultAsync method is called once when anonymous basket does not exist.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketItemsWhilePreservingExistingUserBasketItems
methods.description: Test case verifying that items from an anonymous basket are transferred to a user basket, preserving existing items and quantities.

methods.name: RemovesAnonymousBasketAfterUpdatingUserBasket
methods.description: Test case verifying that the anonymous basket is deleted after its items are transferred to the user basket.

methods.name: CreatesNewUserBasketIfNotExists
methods.description: Test case verifying that a new basket is created if the user basket does not already exist.
